description: This file contains a PHP class 'mantis' implementing a minimal wrapper around the Mantis bug tracking API, providing functions for issue retrieval, creation, and auxiliary HTTP request handling.

classes.name: mantis
classes.description: A class providing a PHP API client for Mantis bug tracker REST API, with methods for issue management, user info, and HTTP request handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing API client with context and optional configuration, setting up proxy and curl settings.

methods.name: initCurl
methods.description: Initializes the cURL handle with options, including proxy configuration if provided.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves a specific issue from Mantis by ID.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Placeholder for method to add a new issue to Mantis.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Placeholder for method to add a note/comment to an issue.

methods.name: addExternalLinks
methods.description: Placeholder for method to add external links to an issue.

methods.name: addTags
methods.description: Placeholder for method to add tags to an issue.

methods.name: getMyUserInfo
methods.description: Fetches information about the authenticated user.

methods.name: _get
methods.description: Helper method to perform an HTTP GET request and parse JSON response.

methods.name: _request_json
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request (GET by default) and decodes the response JSON.

methods.name: _request
methods.description: Performs the actual cURL HTTP request with method, URL, and optional payload, including error handling.
